name: Mount Eliza Farmers Market
address: Mount Eliza Village, Mt Eliza VIC 3930
signature: A smaller community farmers market in Mount Eliza village, producers drawn from the Mornington corridor.
editorNote: Mount Eliza Farmers Market lists the fourth Sunday of each month, 9am–1pm, at Mount Eliza Village. Check the organiser for the current date and any changes before making the trip.

heroImage.alt: Brightly painted bathing boxes along a sandy beach, people on the sand and houses among trees on the hillside above.
heroImage.depicts: brightly painted bathing boxes along a bay beach below a wooded hillside
